title: VIXEN codegen configure must provision a missing Vulkan SDK
body: The VIXEN configure path downloaded and extracted a 320 MB Vulkan SDK into the worktree before codegen/build could run; the facade/tooling should provide a pinned reusable provider or make this dependency explicit ahead of the witness.

title: VIXEN configure must provision missing X11 development headers
body: The VIXEN configure path downloaded and staged X11 development headers into VIXEN/.windowing-deps before the consumer could configure; the facade/tooling should expose a shared pre-provisioned dependency or an explicit readiness check.

title: VIXEN configure requires a manually supplied UNDERTOW_ROOT
body: The VIXEN Text library rejects configure unless UNDERTOW_ROOT is injected into the environment; the assigned Undertow worktree was otherwise discoverable from the lane context, so the consumer/tooling should carry this dependency declaratively or validate it before configure.

title: VIXEN codegen must provide a warning-clean pinned CodegenTool artifact
body: The VIXEN drift target had to materialize and rebuild CodegenTool from the pinned kernel snapshot in ~/.cache/vixen/kernel-codegen before checks could run; that rebuild emitted 26 NETSDK1188 invalid-locale warnings. The facade/tooling should provide a warning-clean shared artifact or published per-pin tool cache.

title: VIXEN configure must expose its source subdirectory clearly
body: From the VIXEN repository root, cmake -S . fails because the product CMakeLists.txt lives under VIXEN/. The supported configure path requires manually knowing and supplying -S VIXEN; the repo-level workflow should expose or wrap the source directory.

title: CodegenTool callable/view outputs should accept documented relative paths
body: A direct --view EditorLayers probe with relative --out-header .tmp-editor-layers-probe.g.h aborted in CodegenModuleDefinition with ArgumentException: The value cannot be an empty string (Parameter path). The VIXEN CMake path is absolute, but direct generation requires a manually resolved absolute output path; the CLI should normalize or reject relative paths clearly.

title: VIXEN drift target names should be stable across fresh configure
body: The prior VIXEN drift witness used codegen/<target> names, but a fresh configure exposed the same checks only as unprefixed targets such as glyph_outline_instance_check and callables_check. The workflow had to run cmake --build --target help and manually normalize the target list before the witness could run; expose stable target names or a documented aggregate target.
